import { defineTable, col, rel, pgEnum } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { users } from "./users";
import { noteComments } from "./note_comments";

const noteStatusEnum = pgEnum("note_status_enum", ["open", "closed", "hidden"]);

// Introspection notes:
//   - the many-to-many with users through note_subscriptions is declared on users only: declaring it here too would re-key note_subscriptions from (user_id, note_id).
export const notes = defineTable("notes", {
    columns: {
        id: col.bigserial({ mode: "number" }).primaryKey(),
        latitude: col.integer().notNull(),
        longitude: col.integer().notNull(),
        tile: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).notNull(),
        updatedAt: col.custom({ dataType: "timestamp without time zone" }).notNull(),
        createdAt: col.custom({ dataType: "timestamp without time zone" }).notNull(),
        status: noteStatusEnum().notNull(),
        closedAt: col.custom({ dataType: "timestamp without time zone" }),
        description: col.text().notNull().default(""),
        userId: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }),
        userIp: col.custom({ dataType: "inet" })
    },
    relations: {
        user: rel.belongsTo(() => users, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        note_comments: rel.hasMany(() => noteComments)
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
